plans.goal: Control the crossroads with overlapping fire and deny enemy advance
steps: Establish forward cover position at the handcart with clear sightlines
Set defensive overwatch on all approach routes
Focus fire to eliminate Col Garrow before he closes distance

atoms.text: Move up to the handcart and establish a firing position
Borin, ready your weapon and watch our left flank for Fitch
Pip, move right to the trees and prepare to strike Col from the side
Sister Maud, hold back and prepare to heal anyone who takes damage
When ready, all units attack Col Garrow together

plans.goal: Disrupt enemy coordination by seizing initiative and attacking scattered forces
steps: Pip immediately pressures Fitch to prevent regrouping
Main squad advances aggressively on Col with covering fire
Eliminate Col before his allies can support him

atoms.text: Pip, charge forward now and strike Fitch before he gets set
Borin and I move toward Col, ready weapons and stay together
Maud, use what you have to suppress Nell's arrows if she fires
Focus all fire on Col Garrow, take him down fast
If arrows come our way, dash to cover or dodge

plans.goal: Establish strong defensive perimeter with coordinated overwatch and elimination from prepared positions
steps: Fall back to tree line with overlapping fields of fire
Set defensive overwatch and deny enemy approach

atoms.text: Fall back to the trees, spread out for covering fields
Take strong positions, everyone set overwatch and ready weapons
Maud, position centrally where you can heal anyone quickly
If Fitch charges in, trip him to disrupt his attack
Fire together on each enemy as they enter our kill zone
